title: Regu Kancil
mood: bouncy, proud and a little cheeky
subject: a ten-year-old in scout troop Regu Kancil at his first Saturday-Sunday school scout camp, where the tent collapses before dark, the girls' troop next door mocks it, the instant noodles burn in the mess tin and his troop still wins the whistle morse-code game, whose message turns out to be 'take a bath'
caption: Indonesian children's film-song pop in the style of a 2020s animated-movie soundtrack, bright and singable. A bouncy upright piano playing on-beat chords; a ukulele strumming quick sixteenths; a glockenspiel doubling the chorus melody; live drums with a light snare and handclaps on two and four; a small string section playing pizzicato in the verses and long bowed lines in the chorus. Clean, warm soundtrack production, uncluttered and cheerful. Young boy lead vocal around ten years old, clear and unforced, a young girl answering in the pre-choruses, and a mixed children's choir joining on every chorus. 124 BPM, G major. Bouncy, proud and a little cheeky. No EDM drop, no trap beat, no autotune, no adult diva belting, no rock guitars.
lyrics:
[Intro - piano, ukulele and glockenspiel]

[Verse 1 - Boy]
Sabtu sore, Persami pertamaku
Tenda Regu Kancil berdiri paling miring
Pasaknya kurang dua, talinya kepanjangan
Kak Pembina geleng-geleng sambil ketawa

[Pre-Chorus - Girl]
Kami Regu Melati, sudah masak dari tadi
Tenda kalian kok kayak jemuran, sih?

[Chorus - Boy and children's choir]
Regu Kancil, jangan pulang dulu
Mi gosong di nesting tetap kita habisin
Regu Kancil, bersembilan satu tenda
Kakiku nyasar ke muka Bimo di ujung

[Verse 2 - Boy]
Malamnya ada lomba sandi morse
Peluit pendek panjang dari depan kelas
Titik, garis, titik, kutulis di bawah senter
Ternyata pesannya cuma satu kata: mandi!

[Pre-Chorus - Girl]
Kami masih ngitung titik, kalian sudah angkat tangan
Oke deh, kali ini Kancil juara satu

[Chorus - Boy and children's choir]
Regu Kancil, jangan pulang dulu
Tenda miring juga tetap tenda kita
Regu Kancil, juara sandi morse
Walaupun belum ada yang beneran mandi

[Bridge - handclaps and glockenspiel]

[Chorus - Boy, Girl and children's choir]
Regu Kancil, Minggu siang pulang
Pita juara kita gantung di kelas
Regu Kancil, tendanya kita lipat
Bau asap api unggun kebawa sampai rumah

[Outro - ukulele and glockenspiel, children cheer]
